findings.description: render_finish applies pending intervals via make_step without checking whether the bar is hidden. It also runs on the exit path for a bar that was abandoned part-way, so the bar is marked at its completed position rather than where it stopped.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a ProgressBar context exits early (for example an exception or break inside the with block) while _completed_intervals is nonzero. Mechanism: __exit__ calls render_finish, which now calls make_step with the pending steps. That can push pos to or past length, setting finished=True and redrawing. Impact: the bar shows a misleading final position and may be marked finished. Because the added code calls make_step and render_progress before the hidden/non-tty check, it also does work on hidden bars.
